packet.headline_seed: Russian superyacht sails through Strait of Hormuz despite blockade

clean_source_blocks.text: The 141m-long vessel, linked to a close ally of Russian President Vladimir Putin, cleared the waterway despite an ongoing blockade.
A superyacht linked to one of Russian President Vladimir Putin's key allies has sailed through the Strait of Hormuz, despite the ongoing blockade of the critical shipping channel.
A superyacht linked to a sanctioned Russian oligarch and key Putin ally has glided through the Strait of Hormuz despite the ongoing blockades.

A superyacht linked to the sanctioned Russian billionaire Alexey Mordashov has navigated the Strait of Hormuz, a highly sensitive shipping lane at the epicentre of the US-Iran conflict, shipping data has revealed.
